body:
Two cross-model (codex/GPT) adversarial-review findings on the merged T9 push/create path (PR #33). FIX both with TDD.

Finding 1 (HIGH, duplicate issues under the DEFAULT label-scoped selector): createIssue attaches no label, and the create adoption scan only searches the selector-scoped issue list and ignores the nodeId/number already stored in pendingCreates. A crash after the remote create but before renderAndPush labels the issue leaves an UNLABELED orphan that the next run's label-scoped listIssues cannot see, so adoption misses and a DUPLICATE issue is created. Fix: (a) when pendingCreates[key] carries a number/nodeId, adopt that issue DIRECTLY (verify via issue view) instead of relying on the selector-scoped body scan; (b) attach the configured createLabel at create time so the new issue immediately belongs to the selected set. The body-key scan remains the fallback when pendingCreates was lost.

Finding 2 (HIGH, stale edges published to the tracker): the create loop reads `desired = pickBlock(t)` from the ORIGINAL localTickets snapshot, but reassignId rewrites the working `tickets` array. A dependent ticket created later (T8 edges->T7) serializes its STALE T<n> edge into the remote issue body + syncedHash while tickets.json gets the rewritten gh: edge, leaving the tracker an invalid sync source until the next push. Fix: in the create loop, derive `desired` from the CURRENT reassigned working `tickets` entry (by id), not the stale snapshot.

Acceptance criteria:
1. test/github.test.mjs: the stateful fake's listIssues HONORS the label selector (only returns issues carrying the selected labels). A new test: create succeeds, labeling is skipped/crashes (unlabeled orphan) -> a re-run with a label-scoped selector ADOPTS via pendingCreates (no second `issue create` call); assert exactly one remote issue.
2. test/github.test.mjs: createIssue attaches the configured createLabel at create time (the new issue is in the label-scoped selection immediately).
3. test/github.test.mjs: multi-create T7 + T8(edges->T7) under --write -> assert T8's REMOTE issue body block carries edge to gh:owner/repo#<T7-number>, NOT 'T7'; and its sidecar syncedHash matches the rewritten block.
4. Full suite green; re-prosecute with adlc:prosecutor (P5) to CLEAR; THEN a cross-model adversarial-review pass (codex) before merge (the lesson from this finding).
title: Fix create idempotency: selector-independent crash recovery + edge rewrite before remote serialize
